description.zh_cn: 练习绘制 Note、Flick、Hold 与折线，再使用拖拽工具编辑它们，最后清理练习物件。进入前请先打开项目，并在标签页中打开至少一张谱面。
description.en_us: Draw a Note, Flick, Hold, and polyline, edit them with Move, then remove the practice objects. Open a project and a beatmap editor tab first.

title.zh_cn: 绘制、编辑并删除练习物件
title.en_us: Draw, edit, and remove practice objects

body.zh_cn: 点击上方标签栏中的任意谱面编辑器标签，进入对应谱面的编辑区。已有多个谱面标签时可任选其一。
body.en_us: Click any beatmap editor tab in the top tab bar. If several beatmaps are open, choose any one.

prompt.zh_cn: 点击突出显示的任意谱面编辑器标签页。
prompt.en_us: Click any highlighted beatmap editor tab.

body.zh_cn: 在工具选择区选择绘制工具。若绘制工具已经选中，可直接点击引导中的 **知道了**，不需要先切换到其他工具再切回来。
body.en_us: Choose the Draw tool in the tool selector. If Draw is already active, use **Got it** without switching away and back.

prompt.zh_cn: 选择绘制工具；若它已经选中，点击“知道了”继续。
prompt.en_us: Choose Draw, or click Got it if Draw is already active.

body.zh_cn: 在画布上按住鼠标中键向右拖动，直到主轨道编辑区完整显示。
body.en_us: Hold the middle mouse button and drag right until the player-lane editor is fully visible.

prompt.zh_cn: 按住中键向右拖动画布，直到主轨道编辑区完整显示。
prompt.en_us: Hold middle mouse and drag right until the player lanes are fully visible.

body.zh_cn: 这里是主轨道编辑区，接下来会在这里练习放置一个玩家实际游玩的单 Note。
body.en_us: This is the player-lane editor. Next you will place one single playable Note here.

prompt.zh_cn: 这里是主轨道编辑区，点击“知道了”继续。
prompt.en_us: This is the player-lane editor. Click Got it to continue.

title.en_us: Drag to place a single Note

body.zh_cn: 从蓝色起点框按住左键，沿提示路径拖到黄色目标框，并在灯泡图标处松开。起点和目标位于不同的随机轨道与确定分拍位置；直接点击目标不会完成。放置失败时，本次临时 Note 会自动撤销。
body.en_us: Hold the left mouse button inside the blue source box, follow the path to the yellow target, and release over the light-bulb marker. The source and destination use different random lanes and exact beat positions; clicking the target directly does not count. A failed placement is automatically discarded.

prompt.zh_cn: 从蓝色起点框按住左键，拖到带灯泡的黄色目标框内再松开。
prompt.en_us: Hold left mouse in the blue source box, drag to the yellow light-bulb target, then release.

title.zh_cn: 按住 Shift 横向绘制滑键 Flick
title.en_us: Hold Shift and drag horizontally to draw a Flick

body.zh_cn: 滑键 Flick 先于长条练习。请确保已开启 **编辑 → 折线编辑**。按住 Shift，从蓝色起点框按下左键，保持 Shift 和左键，沿同一分拍线水平拖到另一轨的黄色灯泡框后松开左键。不要上下拖动，否则可能变成长条或折线。两端位于刚才单键附近的同一真实拍线上；直接点击终点、未按住 Shift 或放置错误都会取消本次操作，不影响已有音符。至少需要两条玩家轨道；若跳过了单键，请重新演练先放单键。
body.en_us: Practice Flick before Hold. Enable **Edit → Polyline editing** first. Hold Shift, press left mouse in the blue source box, and drag horizontally along the same beat line to the yellow light-bulb box on another lane. Release left mouse there while keeping Shift held. Vertical movement may create a Hold or Polyline instead. Both ends use one actual beat line near the previous single Note. Clicking the endpoint directly, missing Shift, or incorrect placement cancels this attempt without changing existing notes. At least two player lanes are required; restart and place the single Note first if you skipped it.

prompt.zh_cn: 按住 Shift，从蓝框沿同一分拍线水平拖到另一轨的黄色灯泡框后松开左键。需开启“编辑 → 折线编辑”；无目标时请返回单键附近，或重新演练先放单键。
prompt.en_us: Hold Shift and drag horizontally from blue to the yellow bulb on another lane, then release left mouse. Enable Edit → Polyline editing. If no target appears, return near the single Note or restart and place it first.

title.zh_cn: 按住 Shift 拖动放置长条
title.en_us: Hold Shift and drag to place a Hold

body.zh_cn: 在刚才单键附近的另一条轨道上，先按住 Shift，再从蓝色起点框按下左键，保持 Shift 和左键按住，沿同一轨道拖到带灯泡的黄色终点框后松开左键。路径会避开刚才 Flick 的头部和横向连接体。两端都对齐实际分拍线；忘记按 Shift、跨轨或未拖到指定终点时会取消本次放置。若刚才跳过了单键，请重新演练并先放置单键；至少需要两条玩家轨道。
body.en_us: On a different lane near the single Note you just placed, hold Shift first, press left mouse in the blue source box, and keep both held while dragging along the same lane to the yellow light-bulb endpoint. Release left mouse there. The path avoids the previous Flick head and horizontal body. Both ends use actual beat lines. Missing Shift, changing lanes, or missing the endpoint cancels the attempt. If you skipped the single Note, restart and place it first. At least two player lanes are required.

prompt.zh_cn: 按住 Shift，从蓝框沿同轨拖到黄色灯泡框再松开。目标会避开上一步 Flick；若没有目标，请滚动或缩放画布以显示安全拍线。
prompt.en_us: Hold Shift and drag from blue to the yellow bulb on the same lane, then release. The target avoids the previous Flick. If no target appears, scroll or zoom until a safe beat line is visible.

title.zh_cn: 连续绘制至少五段折线
title.en_us: Draw a polyline with at least five segments

body.zh_cn: 保持开启 **编辑 → 折线编辑**。按住 Shift，从蓝色 1 号框按下左键，保持左键按住，沿画布上的箭头和编号依次经过 2 至 7 号框，再在黄色 7 号框松开。路径依次生成 Hold → Flick → Hold → Flick → Hold；6 到 7 继续延长最后一段 Hold，避免末段零长度被清理。整个过程保持 Shift，不要按 Ctrl；没有按顺序经过目标或最终不足五段时，本次练习不会写入谱面。
body.en_us: Keep Edit → Polyline editing enabled. Hold Shift and press left mouse in the blue box 1. Keep the button held and follow the arrows through boxes 2 to 7 in order, then release in yellow box 7. The route forms Hold → Flick → Hold → Flick → Hold; continue from 6 to 7 to extend the last Hold beyond zero length. Keep Shift held and avoid Ctrl. An out-of-order gesture or fewer than five final subnotes is discarded.

prompt.zh_cn: 按住 Shift，从蓝色 1 号框起笔，保持左键依次经过箭头指向的 2～7 号框，在黄色 7 号框松开。若没有路线，请滚动或缩放画布以显示更多拍线。
prompt.en_us: Hold Shift, start in blue box 1, follow boxes 2–7 while holding left mouse, and release in yellow box 7. If no route appears, scroll or zoom to show more beat lines.

body.zh_cn: 在工具栏选择拖拽工具，接下来修改刚绘制的练习物件。
body.en_us: Choose Move in the toolbar to edit the objects you just drew.

prompt.zh_cn: 点击拖拽工具；若已选中，可点击“知道了”继续。
prompt.en_us: Click Move, or use Got it if it is already active.

body.zh_cn: 按住高亮单 Note 的头部，拖到另一轨或另一拍位后松开。
body.en_us: Drag the highlighted Note head to another lane or beat position and release.

prompt.zh_cn: 从高亮单 Note 头部按住左键，移动至少一轨或一拍后松开。
prompt.en_us: Drag the highlighted Note head to a different lane or beat.

body.zh_cn: 拖动高亮 Hold 尾部，使长条延长或缩短；不要拖动头部。
body.en_us: Drag the highlighted Hold tail to lengthen or shorten it; leave the head in place.

prompt.zh_cn: 拖动高亮的 Hold 尾部到另一拍位后松开。
prompt.en_us: Drag the highlighted Hold tail to another beat.

title.zh_cn: 修改 Flick 滑动距离

body.zh_cn: 拖动高亮 Flick 箭头到另一个终点轨道，改变横向滑动距离。需要至少三条玩家轨道可选。
body.en_us: Drag the highlighted Flick arrow to another destination lane. This requires at least three player lanes.

prompt.zh_cn: 拖动高亮的 Flick 箭头到另一轨后松开。
prompt.en_us: Drag the highlighted Flick arrow to another lane.

body.zh_cn: 按住高亮的折线中间 Hold 连接段，横向拖到另一轨；这会移动该段与后续折线。暂时避开上一段 Flick 的起点轨，以便下一步继续观察结构；这一步需要至少三条玩家轨道。
body.en_us: Drag the highlighted internal Hold body sideways to another lane. It moves this segment and the following path. Avoid the previous Flick's start lane for now; this step requires at least three player lanes.

prompt.zh_cn: 按住高亮的中间 subHold 身体，横向拖到另一轨后松开。
prompt.en_us: Drag the highlighted internal subHold body sideways to another lane.

body.zh_cn: 按住高亮的折线中间 Flick 连接段，沿时间方向拖到另一拍位；相邻 Hold 的长度会随之调整。先避开前一段 Hold 的起点，下一步再练习合并。
body.en_us: Drag the highlighted internal Flick body to another beat. The adjacent Hold changes length. Avoid the previous Hold start for now; the next step will merge there.

prompt.zh_cn: 按住高亮的中间 subFlick 身体，纵向拖到另一拍位后松开。
prompt.en_us: Drag the highlighted internal subFlick body to another beat.

body.zh_cn: 将折线中间的 subFlick 沿时间拖到前一段 Hold 的起点，让 Hold 缩为零；松手后相邻子段会合并，折线也可能退化成普通 Hold。
body.en_us: Drag the internal subFlick to the previous Hold's start beat. The Hold collapses, neighboring segments merge, and the polyline may become a single Hold.

prompt.zh_cn: 横向拖动高亮的中间 subHold，直到前一段 Flick 消失并形成合并。
prompt.en_us: Drag the highlighted internal subFlick to the previous Hold's start beat and release.

body.zh_cn: 选择绘制工具，准备从已有物件的尾部继续绘制。
body.en_us: Choose Draw to continue from the tail of an existing object.

prompt.zh_cn: 点击绘制工具；若已选中，可点击“知道了”继续。
prompt.en_us: Click Draw, or use Got it if it is already active.

title.zh_cn: 将 Hold 或 Flick 扩展成折线
title.en_us: Extend a Hold or Flick into a polyline

body.zh_cn: 在高亮的 Hold 尾部按住 Shift 和左键向另一轨拖动，或从 Flick 箭头拖到更晚的拍位；松手后原物件扩展为折线。
body.en_us: Hold Shift and drag from the highlighted Hold tail to another lane, or from the Flick arrow to a later beat; release to extend it into a polyline.

prompt.zh_cn: 从高亮的 Hold 或 Flick 尾部按住 Shift 和左键，拖动续出新段后松开。
prompt.en_us: Hold Shift and drag from either highlighted tail to add a segment.

body.zh_cn: 在刚扩展出的折线尾部按住 Shift 和左键，继续向新轨道或拍位绘制；也可回拖修改末段，再松开提交。
body.en_us: Hold Shift and left mouse at the highlighted tail of the polyline you just extended. Draw to a new lane or beat, or drag back to rewrite its last segment, then release.

prompt.zh_cn: 从高亮折线尾部按住 Shift 和左键，续写新段或回写末段后松开。
prompt.en_us: Hold Shift and drag from the highlighted polyline tail to continue or rewrite it.

title.zh_cn: 删除原 Hold 练习物件
title.en_us: Remove the original Hold practice object

body.zh_cn: 右键删除物件，shift+右键删除整个折线
body.en_us: Right-click to delete an object; Shift+right-click to delete the entire polyline.

prompt.zh_cn: 右键删除物件，shift+右键删除整个折线
prompt.en_us: Right-click to delete an object; Shift+right-click to delete the entire polyline.

body.zh_cn: 右键删除物件，shift+右键删除整个折线
body.en_us: Right-click to delete an object; Shift+right-click to delete the entire polyline.

prompt.zh_cn: 右键删除物件，shift+右键删除整个折线
prompt.en_us: Right-click to delete an object; Shift+right-click to delete the entire polyline.
